svg.title: PrefixCache calls step by step
svg.text: PrefixCache: Mei's and Kenji's system messages (365 and 361 tokens), 16 tokens a page
PageKey(parent, page_tokens) for Mei's first two pages, and for page 1's tokens with kRootKey as parent
page 1's key: its parent is page 0's key
the same tokens under another parent: another key, so Match never finds them here
22 full pages, all new: Retain (1 → 2 owners), key appended to recency_
pages 0–19 found: Retain, move to the back; page 20 differs from Mei's: break
pages 0–19 found: moved to the back; Kenji's pages 23 and 24 are new
KvCacheManager::Release: each of Kenji's pages loses one owner
skips 22 pages with 2 owners (a sequence and the cache); page 23 has 1: Release
Teal: cached; amber: added or moved to the back by the call; gray: skipped; coral: miss or evicted. Under a page: its ref count.
PageKey: mix the parent's key, then each of the page's 16 tokens
Insert, new page: Retain it, append its key to recency_, store parent, tokens and page in entries_
Match: key each page from its parent's; stop at the first miss
EvictOne: the first page in recency_ with ref count 1 leaves the cache and is released
